title: New roleDisplay unit test is collected by NEITHER runner — dead test, false coverage confidence
proof: vitest.config.mjs:17 sets `include: ['tests/js/**/*.spec.js']`. The new test lives at tests/Unit/ (wrong dir) with suffix `.js` (not `.spec.js`) → Vitest reports `No test files found` for both `npx vitest run tests/Unit/RoleDisplayHelperTest.js` and `npx vitest run roleDisplay`. tests/Unit/ is the PHPUnit dir (phpunit.xml:9 `<directory suffix="Test.php">./tests/Unit`), which matches only `*Test.php`, never a `.js` file. So `npm test` (vitest run) AND `php artisan test` both skip it. The helper LOGIC is correct — under an explicit override config (`include: ['tests/Unit/RoleDisplayHelperTest.js']`) all 6 tests pass (mapped keys, raw-name fallback, null/undefined/empty -> '', no-translator fallback, label.* namespace). The test is dead, not wrong.
reproduction: From worktree: `npx vitest run tests/Unit/RoleDisplayHelperTest.js` -> 'No test files found, exiting with code 1'. Override `--config` with include=['tests/Unit/RoleDisplayHelperTest.js'] -> '6 passed'. Same orphan class as MEMORY WP-06 (17 sentinels never collected in CI).
remediation: Move/rename to tests/js/roleDisplay.spec.js (matching the vitest include glob) so CI actually exercises it. Logic unchanged.
